app.running_body: Double click the icon to start recording.
app.no_tray:
The icon could not be embedded into the system tray.
Enable the "Notification area" applet in the panel.
Recording can still be toggled with "run.py --toggle".

level.title: Echolot - level test
level.heading: Both bars have to move. Speak into the microphone and play something at the same time.
level.running: Shows the levels of the running recording.
level.local_only: The test runs in this window only, nothing is saved.
settings.title: Echolot - settings
settings.naming_hint:
<small>Audio and log share a name, only the extension differs:
<tt>Echolot_2026-08-12_10-15-03.opus</tt> and <tt>… .log</tt></small>
settings.language_hint:
<small>Takes effect immediately for the menu; windows that are
already open keep the language they were opened with.</small>
settings.layout_split: Two separate channels: you left, other side right
settings.tracks_hint:
<small>Who spoke when is in the log either way - it is measured
per side before mixing. Only people talking at the same time
cannot be separated in a mixed track.</small>
settings.preroll_off: Off (recording starts at the double click)
settings.preroll_hint_off:
<small>Without a pre-roll, everything said before the double click
is lost.</small>
settings.preroll_hint_on: The double click also puts the last {minutes} minutes into the file. Costs {memory} of memory - and the microphone is permanently in use, because that requires listening all the time.
settings.follow_default: Follow device changes during a recording
settings.adaptive: Take background noise into account automatically
settings.speech_hint:
<small>Only decides what is noted as a speech section in the log.
The audio file always contains everything.</small>
